author: (A. A. Gould, 1850)

note.en: A thin, irregular, pearly clam of up to about 25 mm that is known here from three museum specimens taken by divers at 2 to 25 m off Gandoca-Manzanillo and Manzanillo. It lives hidden in crevices and is not something a snorkeler will notice.
note.es: Una almeja delgada, irregular y nacarada de hasta unos 25 mm que aquí se conoce por tres ejemplares de museo tomados por buzos entre 2 y 25 m frente a Gandoca-Manzanillo y Manzanillo. Vive escondida en grietas y un buceador con snorkel difícilmente la nota.

evidence: GBIF: 3 preserved specimen(s) in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2000 and 2003)
Records at Punta Mona sector, in front of Manzanillo and 2.5 km north of the Manzanillo cemetery

sources.t: Shell Museum (Sanibel): Entodesma brasiliense, shell size to 25 mm
GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection and other museum records), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: INBio specimens at Punta Mona and Manzanillo.
